proposed_claim: Test split size is exactly 163 authentic claim-evidence pairs from X-Fact Hindi
allowed_wording: Test set evaluated contains exactly N=163 authentic Hindi claim-evidence pairs from X-Fact
limitation: Limited to Hindi-English language pair

proposed_claim: Test split contains severe class imbalance with zero gold SUPPORTED examples
allowed_wording: Test split consists of 142 CONTRADICTED and 21 INSUFFICIENT with 0 gold SUPPORTED
limitation: True 3-class evaluation bounded; accuracy capped by majority class

proposed_claim: Evidence snippets are pre-retrieved and do not evaluate end-to-end RAG retrieval
allowed_wording: Study evaluates cross-lingual evidence verification on pre-retrieved evidence snippets
limitation: Does not evaluate upstream retriever or downstream generative QA

proposed_claim: Machine translation is Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-hi-en running locally on CPU
allowed_wording: Evidence translated using Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-hi-en MarianMT model on CPU
limitation: Evaluates one translation architecture; not generalized to frontier LLM translators

proposed_claim: Verifier is mDeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned on multilingual NLI (XNLI)
allowed_wording: Cross-lingual verifier is mDeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned on multilingual XNLI
limitation: Evaluates single encoder verifier; does not evaluate generative verifiers

proposed_claim: Paired prediction disagreement between original and translated evidence is 63.80%
allowed_wording: Observed paired prediction disagreement between original and translated evidence is 63.80%
limitation: Reflects model prediction sensitivity not human-verified translation error

proposed_claim: Directional flip from translated SUPPORTED to original CONTRADICTED occurs on 48.44%
allowed_wording: When translated evidence predicts SUPPORTED; original Hindi evidence flips to CONTRADICTED on 48.44%
limitation: Evaluated on subset of 64 translated SUPPORTED predictions

proposed_claim: No-Check translated verification achieves 28.22% test accuracy
allowed_wording: No-Check pipeline achieves 28.22% test accuracy (46/163)
limitation: Heavily penalized by class skew and missing positive class

proposed_claim: Direct Multilingual verification on original Hindi achieves 42.94% accuracy
allowed_wording: Direct Multilingual verification achieves 42.94% test accuracy (70/163)
limitation: Incurs 3.1x higher latency (11295.6 ms vs 3650.4 ms)

proposed_claim: Always-Check dual consensus achieves 36.81% accuracy
allowed_wording: Always-Check dual-consensus averaging achieves 36.81% accuracy (60/163)
limitation: Incurs 4.1x higher latency (14945.9 ms vs 3650.4 ms)

proposed_claim: Selective-Check cascade at tau*=0.650 achieves 28.22% accuracy and 7.98% coverage
allowed_wording: Selective-Check with threshold tau*=0.650 achieves 28.22% accuracy with 7.98% coverage
limitation: Does not improve test accuracy over No-Check; matches it exactly (46 vs 46)

proposed_claim: No-Check vs Direct Multilingual McNemar test reports b=27 c=51 chi2=6.7821 p=0.008772
allowed_wording: No-Check vs Direct Multilingual exhibits discordant pairs b=27 and c=51 (exact p=0.008772)
limitation: Evaluates paired marginal accuracy differences; does not prove causality

proposed_claim: Selective-Check vs Direct Multilingual McNemar test reports b=23 c=47 chi2=7.5571 p=0.005583
allowed_wording: Selective-Check vs Direct Multilingual exhibits discordant pairs b=23 and c=47 (exact p=0.005583)
limitation: Evaluates paired marginal accuracy differences with distinct denominator 70

proposed_claim: Paired permutation tests on Macro-F1 show no statistically significant difference vs Direct Multi
allowed_wording: Paired permutation tests on Macro-F1 (B=5000; seed=42) do not reach significance vs Direct Multilingual
limitation: Macro-F1 subject to high variance under severe class skew; differs from McNemar

proposed_claim: Failure partition of N=117 translation errors shows 51 S_trans and 66 S_verif
allowed_wording: Among 117 translation errors; 51 are corrected by original Hindi while 66 fail across both
limitation: Diagnostic error stratum based on model predictions; not human causal adjudication

proposed_claim: Success partition of N=46 translated successes shows 19 Control and 27 S_degraded
allowed_wording: Among 46 translated successes; 19 succeed in both languages while 27 fail under original Hindi
limitation: Original Hindi evidence degrades 27 instances that translated text classified correctly

proposed_claim: Zero-check baseline utility on dev exceeds selective cascade peak utility
allowed_wording: On development data No-Check baseline achieves higher penalized utility J than cascade peak
limitation: Cascade is optimal conditional on cascade activation; not globally Pareto-dominant

proposed_claim: Test split was previously inspected during exploratory iterations
allowed_wording: Evaluations on the test partition are diagnostic and exploratory as split was inspected earlier
limitation: Must not be framed as an untouched confirmatory holdout evaluation

proposed_claim: Human bilingual annotation is pending external participant recruitment
verified_value: Human annotation pending; synthetic data quarantined
allowed_wording: Bilingual human validation remains pending external participant recruitment
limitation: Semantic translation distortion cannot be claimed as causal mechanism

allowed_wording: Findings characterized on Hindi-to-English translation verification on X-Fact benchmark
